description: This file defines the Theme model class for the OpenCart admin design module. It includes methods for creating, updating, deleting, and retrieving theme records in the database.
external_files: Database connection or abstraction layer (implied via $this->db)

classes.name: Theme
classes.description: Model class for handling theme-related database operations in the OpenCart admin design module.

methods.name: addTheme
methods.description: Inserts a new theme record into the database with provided data.

methods.name: editTheme
methods.description: Updates an existing theme record identified by theme_id with new data.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Changes the active status of a theme identified by theme_id.

methods.name: deleteTheme
methods.description: Removes a theme record from the database by theme_id.

methods.name: deleteThemesByStoreId
methods.description: Deletes all themes associated with a specific store_id.

methods.name: getTheme
methods.description: Retrieves a single theme record by theme_id.

methods.name: getThemes
methods.description: Fetches a list of themes, optionally limited by start and limit parameters.

methods.name: getTotalThemes
methods.description: Returns the total count of theme records in the database.
